intro: The Maldives is the world's lowest country, with about 1,200 coral islands in 26 atolls.

chapters.title: Atolls
text: An atoll is a ring of coral islands around a lagoon. About 200 islands are lived on, and many others are resorts.
The average height is about 1.5 m above sea level, and the highest natural point is only about 2.4 m.

chapters.title: Rising seas
text: Rising sea levels threaten the islands, and warming water bleaches coral. The government has built an artificial, higher island, Hulhumalé.

keyTerms.meaning: A ring of coral islands around a lagoon.
When warm water makes coral lose its colour and can kill it.
